# PLAN — iteration 5
## Current state assessment
The incumbent is timing-feasible at WNS 0.807 ns and WHS 0.416 ns. The seed already registers the products and reduces them with a carry-save tree, so this iteration should target the remaining `s6 + c6` final adder; to improve `maximize_freq`, it must strictly improve register-to-register setup slack over 0.807 ns while retaining every verification and metric gate.

## Hypothesis
Replacing the 32-bit final carry chain with four 8-bit carry-select sections may improve register-to-register timing at the cost of additional LUTs and routing.

## Instruction for generator
Keep the delay line, product registers, carry-save tree, output register, synchronous reset behavior, parameters, interface, and `// @latency 1` unchanged. Replace only `sum_all = s6 + c6` with a combinational 32-bit carry-select adder: compute each 8-bit section’s sum for carry-in 0 and 1 in parallel, then select each section’s result using the preceding section’s carry. Preserve signed interpretation and the original modulo-32-bit result for all supported coefficient values.
